entities.summary: Hans Konrad Pestalozzi was a Swiss architect and politician who served as mayor (president) of the city of Zurich from 1889 to 1909. He was also a member of the Swiss Federal Assembly, serving in both the National Council and the Grand Council of Zurich. Pestalozzi played a significant role in the urban development of Zurich during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
